issues.issue: Mixed fees and fines label. The Statement of Activities groups it under 'Fees, Fines, and Charges for Services', so this is defensible, but the 'Fines and Licenses' category could also fit. The same applies to detail[2].

The function comes from the Public Works heading. County communication equipment (radio/dispatch) is more likely public safety than roads. The heading supports the current category, so this is a judgment call.

The printed label says Miscellaneous, so 'other' follows the rules. However, 13% of governmental receipts are in other (over the 10% review threshold). Road Fund Miscellaneous 1,264,934 is far above its 675,200 budget and is unexplained on the trimmed pages; it may be reimbursements or FEMA money.
